prose:
A DataSketches contributor describes encountering hardcoded tables while porting CPC cardinality estimation to Rust and trying to reconstruct the missing program that produced them. The examined opening explains how full coupon-state compression differs from keeping only per-bucket maxima.

This summary covers the motivation and algorithm context, not the complete later reconstruction or its AI-assisted steps. The reported production experience and compression comparison were not independently tested, and no original source recovery is established merely by matching some outputs.
highlights: CPC stores more state before compression
Examined opening does not cover full reconstruction
Reported savings were not benchmarked here
